name: CreateLoadBalancer

parameters.help_en: The type of the Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance. Set the value to network, which indicates an NLB instance
parameters.help_zh: 负载均衡的类型，仅取值：network，表示网络型负载均衡
parameters.name: load_balancer_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the NLB instance.

It must be 2 to 128 characters in length, can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例名称。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以大小写英文字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: load_balancer_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of IPv4 addresses used for the NLB instance. Valid values are:

Internet: The nodes of an Internet-facing NLB instance have public IP addresses. The DNS name of an Internet-facing NLB instance is publicly resolvable to the public IP addresses of the nodes. Therefore, Internet-facing NLB instances can route requests from clients over the Internet.

Intranet: The nodes of an internal-facing NLB instance have only private IP addresses. The DNS name of an internal-facing NLB instance is publicly resolvable to the private IP addresses of the nodes. Therefore, internal-facing NLB instances can route requests only from clients with access to the virtual private cloud (VPC) for the NLB instance.

To enable a public IPv6 address for a dual-stack NLB instance, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445878.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例的IPv4地址类型。取值：

Internet：负载均衡具有公网IP地址，DNS域名被解析到公网IP，因此可以在公网环境访问。
Intranet：负载均衡只有私网IP地址，DNS域名被解析到私网IP，因此只能被负载均衡所在VPC的内网环境访问。

网络型负载均衡双栈实例的IPv6公网需通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445878.html接口开启
parameters.name: address_type

parameters.help_en:
The version of IP addresses used for the NLB instance. Valid values:

ipv4 (default)

DualStack
parameters.help_zh:
协议版本。取值：

ipv4（默认值）：IPv4类型。
DualStack：双栈类型
parameters.name: address_ip_version

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC where you want to create the NLB instance
parameters.help_zh: 网络型负载均衡实例的专有网络ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the elastic IP address (EIP) that is associated with the Internet-facing NLB instance. Each zone is assigned one EIP. An NLB instance can be deployed in up to 10 zones. If the region supports two or more zones, specify at least two zones
fields.help_zh: 公网实例绑定的EIP实例ID，每个可用区对应1个EIP实例ID。最多支持添加10个可用区。若当前地域支持2个及以上可用区，至少需要添加2个可用区
fields.name: allocation_id

fields.help_en: The local IPv4 addresses. The IP addresses that the NLB instance uses to communicate with the backend servers. The number of IP addresses must be an even number, which must be at least 2 and at most 8
fields.help_zh:
IPv4 Local地址列表。NLB与后端服务交互的地址列表。
地址个数必须是偶数，且最少2个，最多8个
fields.name: ipv4_local_addresses

fields.help_en: The VIP of the IPv6 version. The IPv6 address that the NLB instance uses to provide external services
fields.help_zh: IPv6 VIP地址。NLB对外提供服务的IPv6地址
fields.name: ipv6_address

fields.help_en: The local IPv6 addresses. The IP addresses that the NLB instance uses to communicate with the backend servers. The number of IP addresses must be an even number, which must be at least 2 and at most 8
fields.help_zh:
IPv6 Local地址列表。NLB与后端服务交互的地址列表。
地址个数必须是偶数，且最少2个，最多8个
fields.name: ipv6_local_addresses

fields.help_en: The private virtual IP address (VIP) of the IPv4 version. The private IPv4 address that the NLB instance uses to provide external services
fields.help_zh: IPv4 私网VIP地址。NLB对外提供服务的私网IPv4地址
fields.name: private_ipv4_address

fields.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch in the zone. You can specify only one vSwitch (subnet) in each zone of an NLB instance. An NLB instance can be deployed in up to 10 zones. If the region supports two or more zones, you must specify at least two zones
fields.help_zh:
可用区对应的交换机，每个可用区只能使用一台交换机和一个子网。最多支持添加10个可用区。
若当前地域支持2个及以上的可用区，至少需要添加2个可用区
fields.name: vswitch_id

fields.help_en:
The ID of the zone where the NLB instance is deployed. An NLB instance can be deployed in up to 10 zones. If the region supports two or more zones, specify at least two zones.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443890.html operation to query the most recent zone list
fields.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例的可用区ID。最多支持添加10个可用区。若当前地域支持2个及以上可用区，至少需要添加2个可用区。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443890.html接口获取可用区ID
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The mappings between zones and vSwitches. An NLB instance can be deployed in up to 10 zones. If the region supports two or more zones, you must specify at least two zones
parameters.help_zh: 可用区及交换机映射列表。最多支持添加10个可用区。若当前地域支持2个及以上的可用区，至少需要添加2个可用区
parameters.name: zone_mappings

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance that is associated with the Internet-facing NLB instance
parameters.help_zh: 公网类型实例关联的共享带宽包ID
parameters.name: bandwidth_package_id

fields.help_en:
The billing method of the NLB instance.

Set the value to PostPay, which specifies the pay-as-you-go billing method
fields.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例的计费类型。

仅取值PostPay：表示按量计费
fields.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en: The billing settings of the NLB instance
parameters.help_zh: 网络型负载均衡实例计费配置
parameters.name: load_balancer_billing_config

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Perform a dry run without actually making the request. Valid values are:

true: Perform only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the check, an error message specifying the issue is returned. If the request passes, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): Check the request and perform the operation. If the request passes the check, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned, and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建实例。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token. Ensure that the token is unique among different requests. Only ASCII characters are allowed.

If you do not specify this parameter, the value of RequestId is used.\\ The value of RequestId is different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the NLB instance is deployed.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the deletion protection feature. Valid values:

true

false (default)
fields.help_zh:
删除保护状态，取值：

true：开启状态。
false（默认值）：关闭状态
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The reason why the deletion protection feature is enabled or disabled. The reason must be 2 to 128 characters in length, can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and must start with a letter
fields.help_zh: 更改删除保护状态的原因。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以大小写英文字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
fields.name: reason

parameters.help_en: The configuration of the deletion protection feature
parameters.name: deletion_protection_config

fields.help_en:
The reason for enabling the configuration read-only mode. The reason must be 2 to 128 characters in length, can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and must start with a letter.

This parameter takes effect only when Status is set to ConsoleProtection
fields.help_zh:
输入开启修改保护的原因。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以大小写英文字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。

仅在Status为ConsoleProtection时有效且合法
fields.name: reason

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the configuration read-only mode. Valid values:

NonProtection: does not enable the configuration read-only mode. You cannot set the Reason parameter. If the Reason parameter is set, the value is cleared.

ConsoleProtection: enables the configuration read-only mode. You can set the Reason parameter.

If the parameter is set to ConsoleProtection, the configuration read-only mode is enabled. You cannot modify the configurations of the NLB instance in the NLB console. However, you can call API operations to modify the configurations of the NLB instance
fields.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡修改保护状态。取值：

NonProtection：不保护，表示不允许传入保护配置的Reason。如果配置了保护配置的Reason，则清空其配置信息。
ConsoleProtection：控制台修改保护，此时允许传入保护配置的Reason。

当取值为ConsoleProtection，即开启修改保护后，用户不能通过负载均衡控制台修改实例配置，但可以通过调用API修改实例配置
fields.name: status

parameters.help_en: The configuration of the configuration read-only mode
parameters.name: modification_protection_config

fields.help_en:
The key of the tag. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length, cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag key can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: _ . : / = + - @

You can specify up to 20 tags in each call
fields.help_zh:
标签键。最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`。支持字符包括字母、数字、下划线 (_)、点 (.)、冒号 (:)、斜线 (/)、等号 (=)、加号 (+)、减号 (-)、@符号 (@) 。

一次调用最多支持添加20个标签
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the tag. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag value can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: _ . : / = + - @

You can specify up to 20 tags in each call
fields.help_zh:
标签值。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`。支持字符包括字母、数字、下划线 (_)、点 (.)、冒号 (:)、斜线 (/)、等号 (=)、加号 (+)、减号 (-)、@符号 (@) 。

一次调用最多支持添加20个标签
fields.name: value
